t: The Werner fibreglass 4-step swingback A-frame step ladder is engineered for safe and secure work at height, particularly in electrical environments due to its non-conductive properties. This professional-grade ladder features a multifunctional holster top, keeping essential tools organised and easily accessible. Slip-resistant traction-tread steps ensure comfortable and stable standing during tasks. Robust EDGE bracing helps to prevent rail damage, enhancing the ladder's durability for demanding trade use. With a 1.12m maximum open height, this reliable work platform supports a static vertical load of 150kg.
